title: Face Anti-Spoofing System
description: An AI-powered solution to prevent identity falsification by detecting presentation attacks in facial recognition systems with high accuracy and real-time performance.
overview_p1: This project addresses the critical security challenge of presentation attacks in facial recognition systems. Using deep learning techniques, the system can distinguish between genuine faces and various types of spoofing attempts.
overview_p2: The solution implements a lightweight convolutional neural network architecture optimized for real-time detection while maintaining high accuracy across diverse scenarios.
overview_p3: Extensive testing with various attack types ensures robust protection against evolving spoofing techniques.
features: High accuracy with low false positive rate

challenges.title: Attack Variety Detection
challenges.description: Developed robust detection mechanisms for various presentation attacks including print, replay, and mask attacks.

challenges.title: Real-time Performance
challenges.description: Optimized model architecture to achieve real-time processing speeds without sacrificing accuracy.

challenges.title: Generalization
challenges.description: Ensured model performs well across different lighting conditions, camera qualities, and demographic groups.
